Normal presentation does not expose ConfirmedRequirementContract, LOCAL_DETERMINISTIC_NO_MODEL_CALL, generation bridge, provenance payload, canonical compiler, validation codes, raw Reviewed ReportDesign JSON or internal schema/version identifiers unless genuinely useful in the optional expert disclosure.

A collapsed Details for experts area is optional, permission-respecting and concise; it exposes only authorised diagnostics, relevant identifiers, limitations and validation details and cannot change authority, validation, state or protected cross-company/user information.

Raw ReportDesign JSON is absent from the normal flow while the trusted Package C reviewed-design boundary remains intact. The browser neither invents nor modifies nor approves nor bypasses a design; an unavailable safe reviewed-design input produces an explicit architecture-decision boundary rather than a synthetic design or second compiler.

No report, ready, building, ready, failed, retry, supported cancellation, current version, historical version, stale reconfirmation, denied and unavailable states are truthful, accessible and distinguishable without colour alone.

Package B/C server authority for company and case isolation, membership, CSRF, idempotency, confirmation and evidence binding, ReportDesign validation, canonical pipeline, private artifacts, history, retry/regeneration, stale rejection and current-access rechecks is unchanged or strengthened; browser presentation never creates these decisions.
